title: US Hits Targets Near Iran's Kharg Island, Fox News Says
description:
The US launches attacks on targets near Iran's Kharg Island and the port city of Jask according to Fox News. Iranian oil tankers were hit according to the report. This as brent oil prices hover around $100 a barrel. Bloomberg's Kate Sullivan reports from the White House.
